schema.text: When you ride an e-scooter, what tires you most?

options.text: Physical effort (standing, keeping your balance, carrying bags)
Slopes, stairs and changes in level
Stress (traffic, finding the way, being late, feeling unsafe)
Waiting or standing (at traffic lights, in queues)
I rarely feel tired after my trips
